items.title_cn: 奥马环素相关胰腺损伤：从轻度间质性到复发性胰腺炎及其药物警戒意义
items.title_en: Omadacycline-Associated Pancreatic Injury: a Spectrum from Mild Interstitial to Recrudescent Pancreatitis with Pharmacovigilance Implications
items.abstract_cn: Omadacycline是一种新型氨甲基四环素类抗生素，其安全性特征尚未完全明确，尤其是关于胰腺毒性方面。已有1例omadacycline诱导的急性胰腺炎报道，但多项FDA不良事件报告系统（FAERS）分析均未能检测到胰腺炎信号。我们旨在描述omadacycline相关胰腺损伤的谱系，并探讨以细微或不典型影像学特征就诊病例的药物警戒意义。我们报告了来自重症监护病房的3例病例，患者在使用omadacycline后出现胰腺酶升高（> 3 × ULN），且时间上相关。其他病因已被系统排除。采用Naranjo量表评估因果关系。同时检索了PubMed和Embase文献。所有3例患者均表现为以高脂肪酶血症为主，CT证实存在胰腺损伤，严重程度涵盖不同谱系。病例1（79岁女性）脂肪酶 > 34 × ULN，有腹膜刺激征，新发胰头增大伴胰周条索影（Naranjo 7分）；病例2（18岁男性）无症状性脂肪酶升高，伴弥漫性腺体肿胀及实质密度不均（Naranjo 5分）；病例3（73岁女性）在持续暴露期间出现复发性局灶性胰腺炎，累及胰尾并伴肾周筋膜增厚（Naranjo 4分）。所有患者停药后均好转。常见病因均已排除。既往报道的病例呈现相反模式（以影像学为主，伴轻度酶升高）。综合这4例病例，支持将omadacycline从Badalov IV级上调至III级。Omadacycline可引起一系列胰腺损伤，从轻度间质性胰腺炎到复发性疾病，其CT表现可能不显著且容易被忽视。这种认识不足可能导致漏报，或可解释FAERS中缺乏胰腺炎信号的原因。临床医生应监测脂肪酶和淀粉酶，当酶升高时应保持较低的CT成像阈值，并使用特定的MedDRA术语报告疑似病例。
items.abstract_en: Omadacycline is a novel aminomethylcycline antibiotic with an incompletely characterized safety profile, particularly regarding pancreatic toxicity. A single case of omadacycline-induced acute pancreatitis has been reported, yet multiple FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) analyses have failed to detect a pancreatitis signal. We aimed to characterize the spectrum of omadacycline-associated pancreatic injury and to explore the pharmacovigilance implications of cases presenting with subtle or atypical imaging features. We report three cases from an intensive care unit in which patients developed pancreatic enzyme elevation (> 3 × ULN) temporally associated with omadacycline. Alternative etiologies were systematically excluded. Causality was assessed using the Naranjo scale. A literature search of PubMed and Embase was also performed. All three patients exhibited predominant hyperlipasemia with CT-confirmed pancreatic injury spanning a severity spectrum. Case 1 (79F) showed lipase > 34 × ULN, peritoneal signs, and new pancreatic head enlargement with peripancreatic stranding (Naranjo 7); Case 2 (18M) had asymptomatic lipase elevation with diffuse glandular swelling and heterogeneous parenchymal density (Naranjo 5); Case 3 (73F) developed recrudescent focal pancreatitis during continued exposure, with tail involvement and perirenal fascial thickening (Naranjo 4). All improved after discontinuation. Common etiologies were excluded. The previously reported case showed an inverse pattern (imaging-dominant with mild enzyme elevation). Collectively, these four cases support upgrading omadacycline from Badalov Class IV to Class III. Omadacycline can cause a spectrum of pancreatic injury, from mild interstitial pancreatitis to recrudescent disease, with CT findings that may be unobtrusive and easily overlooked. This underrecognition likely contributes to underreporting, which may explain the absence of a FAERS pancreatitis signal. Clinicians should monitor lipase and amylase, maintain a low threshold for CT imaging when enzymes rise, and report suspected cases using specific MedDRA terms.
items.summary_cn: 该研究报告了3例与omadacycline相关的胰腺损伤病例，表现为从轻度间质性胰腺炎到复发性胰腺炎的严重程度谱系，以高脂肪酶血症为主，CT可见胰腺肿胀、胰周渗出等损伤征象，停药后均改善。结合既往1例报道，作者提出应将omadacycline从Badalov IV类升级为III类，并指出CT表现可能不显著而易被忽视，导致FAERS未能检出胰腺炎信号。

items.title_cn: 超越内镜范围：内镜取石失败后腹腔镜救治空肠胆石性肠梗阻
items.title_en: Beyond the Scope: Laparoscopic Rescue of Jejunal Gallstone Ileus Following Failed Endoscopic Retrieval
items.abstract_cn: 胆石性肠梗阻（GSI）是机械性小肠梗阻的一种不常见但重要的病因，占所有病例的1%~4%，在老年人群中高达25%。它是由较大的胆石经胆肠瘘（最常见为胆囊十二指肠瘘）迁移至肠道所致。尽管较为罕见，但由于诊断延迟及老年患者生理储备显著脆弱，该病在老年患者中具有较高的发病率和死亡率。我们报告一例75岁女性患者，既往有复杂的病史，包括2型糖尿病（T2DM）、高血压（HTN）和III期慢性肾脏病（CKD），因急性近端小肠梗阻就诊。影像学检查显示Rigler三联征，一颗4.1 cm的肠石嵌顿于近端空肠。我们启动了微创“阶梯式”治疗方案，尝试内镜下取石；然而，由于结石体积较大且内镜无法越过嵌顿部位，该尝试未能成功。患者随后接受了腹腔镜肠石取出术。术中行横向肠切开取石，随后行一期横向修补。鉴于患者合并多种基础疾病，为缩短手术时间和减少手术应激，未处理胆肠瘘，也未行胆囊切除术。患者恢复顺利，于术后第4天出院。本病例旨在展示序贯管理策略——从内镜干预过渡到腹腔镜干预——用于近端GSI的安全性和有效性。该病例强调，对于合并多种基础疾病的高危老年患者，单纯腹腔镜肠石取出术相比广泛的一期胆道重建术，是一种确定性且并发症更少的治疗方法，有助于快速康复并减少术前并发症。
items.abstract_en: Gallstone ileus (GSI) is an infrequent yet significant aetiology of mechanical small bowel obstruction, accounting for 1% - 4% of cases overall and up to 25% in the geriatric population. It results from the migration of a large biliary calculus into the intestinal tract via a bilioenteric fistula, most commonly cholecystoduodenal. Despite its rarity, the condition carries high morbidity and mortality in elderly patients due to delayed diagnosis and significant physiological fragility. We present the case of a 75-year-old female with a complex medical history, including type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), hypertension (HTN), and stage III chronic kidney disease (CKD), who presented with acute proximal small bowel obstruction. Radiographic imaging revealed Rigler’s triad, with a 4.1 cm enterolith impacted in the proximal jejunum. A minimally invasive "step-up" approach was initiated with an attempted endoscopic retrieval; however, this was unsuccessful due to the stone's dimensions and the inability to navigate the scope beyond the impaction. The patient subsequently underwent a laparoscopic enterolithotomy. A transverse enterotomy was performed for stone extraction, followed by a primary transverse repair. To minimise operative time and surgical stress in the setting of her comorbidities, the bilioenteric fistula was not addressed, and no cholecystectomy was performed. The patient had an uneventful recovery and was discharged on postoperative Day 4. This case was selected to demonstrate the safety and efficacy of a sequential management strategy - transitioning from endoscopic to laparoscopic intervention - for proximal GSI. It highlights that in high-risk geriatric patients with multiple comorbidities, laparoscopic enterolithotomy alone serves as a definitive and less morbid treatment compared to extensive one- stage biliary reconstruction, facilitating rapid recovery and minimising preoperative complications.
items.journal: Beyond the Scope: Laparoscopic Rescue of Jejunal Gallstone Ileus Following Failed Endoscopic Retrieval
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了一位75岁合并多种基础疾病的高危老年患者，因胆石性肠梗阻导致近端空肠梗阻，在内镜下取石失败后，采用腹腔镜肠切开取石术成功治疗，未处理胆肠瘘及胆囊，患者术后第4天顺利出院。研究表明，对于高危老年患者，内镜转腹腔镜的序贯治疗策略安全有效，单纯腹腔镜肠切开取石术可作为确定性治疗，避免更大范围的手术创伤。

items.title_cn: 早期肠内营养对儿童急性胰腺炎的影响：系统评价与Meta分析
items.title_en: Impact of early enteral nutrition on children with acute pancreatitis: A systematic review and meta analysis
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 目的 系统评价早期肠内营养（EEN）对急性胰腺炎（AP）患儿的影响。方法 检索中国知网（CNKI）、万方、中文科技期刊数据库（VIP）、中国生物医学文献数据库（CBM）、PubMed、Cochrane Library、Embase和Web of Science等数据库自建库至2025年10月1日关于EEN对AP患儿影响的随机对照试验（RCT）和准实验研究。采用RevMan 5.2软件进行数据分析。结果 共纳入9项试验，涉及485例AP患儿。分析显示，与对照组相比，观察组（EEN）在以下结局指标方面表现出显著改善：血清白蛋白（标准化均数差[SMD]=1.28，95%置信区间[CI]=0.68–1.88，p<0.0001）、急性生理学与慢性健康状况评分II（APACHE-II）（SMD=−2.58，95%CI=−4.46至−0.70，p=0.007）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）水平（SMD=−2.23，95%CI=−3.36至−1.10，p=0.0001）以及不良事件发生率（比值比[OR]=0.30，95%CI=0.17–0.52，p<0.0001）。结论 EEN可显著提高AP患儿血清白蛋白水平，降低APACHE-II评分和TNF-α水平，并减少不良事件的发生率。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Objective To systematically evaluate the impact of early enteral nutrition (EEN) on children with acute pancreatitis (AP). Methods Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and quasi‐experimental studies investigating the effects of EEN on children with AP were retrieved from databases including China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), Wanfang, Chinese Scientific Journal Database (VIP), Chinese Biomedical Literature Database (CBM), PubMed, Cochrane Library, Embase, and Web of Science from inception to October 1, 2025. Data analysis was performed using RevMan 5.2 software. Results Nine trials involving 485 children with AP were included. The analysis revealed that the observation group (EEN) demonstrated significant improvements compared to the control group in the following outcomes: serum albumin (standardized mean difference [SMD] = 1.28, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.68–1.88, p < 0.0001), acute physiology and chronic health evaluation II (APACHE‐II) score (SMD = −2.58, 95% CI = −4.46 to −0.70, p = 0.007), tumor necrosis factor‐α (TNF‐α) level (SMD = −2.23, 95% CI = −3.36 to −1.10, p = 0.0001), and incidence of adverse events (odds ratio [OR] = 0.30, 95% CI = 0.17–0.52, p < 0.0001). Conclusion EEN significantly increases serum albumin levels, reduces APACHE‐II scores and TNF‐α levels, and decreases the incidence of adverse events in children with AP.
items.journal: Journal of Pediatric Gastroenterology and Nutrition
items.summary_cn: 该Meta分析纳入9项研究共485例儿童急性胰腺炎患者，发现早期肠内营养较对照组可显著提高血清白蛋白水平、降低APACHE-II评分和TNF-α水平，并减少不良事件发生率。

items.title_cn: 术后早期血清IL-6可能有助于胰腺切除术后胰腺特异性并发症的风险分层
items.title_en: Early postoperative serum IL-6 may contribute to risk stratification for pancreas-specific complications after pancreatic resection
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 目的 已证实血清IL-6水平对术后感染性并发症具有预测价值，并且在急性胰腺炎中具有预后价值。关于其在胰腺切除术后作用的证据有限。本研究旨在分析胰腺切除术后早期血清IL-6对术后并发症的预测作用。方法 对德国一家三级中心接受胰腺切除术的患者进行了回顾性分析。记录了每位患者切除术后48小时内的所有IL-6值。固定术后时间点的数值通过每位患者各次测量值之间进行插值获得，超出测量范围则通过线性混合效应模型进行预测。进行了受试者工作特征曲线分析，并确定了预测术后胰腺瘘（POPF）、胰腺切除术后急性胰腺炎（PPAP）和总体并发症的最佳时间点和截断值。结果 在316例患者中，157例具有一个以上IL-6值的患者被纳入。切除术后36小时的IL-6对所有三个终点均显示出最佳的诊断效能。对于PPAP B/C，AUC为0.800（95% CI 0.685–0.916），截断值为296 pg/ml（敏感性62%，特异性80%，PPV 26%，NPV 95%）；对于POPF B/C，AUC为0.715（0.632–0.798），截断值为192 pg/ml（敏感性70%，特异性59%，PPV 52%，NPV 76%）。对主要并发症（Clavien–Dindo ≥ 3b）的区分能力较弱，AUC为0.636（0.539–0.733），截断值为208 pg/ml（敏感性55%，特异性62%，PPV 44%，NPV 73%）。结论 胰腺切除术后48小时内的血清IL-6可能有助于胰腺特异性并发症的风险评估。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Purpose IL-6 level in serum has been shown to have predictive value for postoperative infectious complications and prognostic value in acute pancreatitis. Evidence on its role after pancreatic resection is limited. The aim of the study was to analyse the predictive role of early postoperative serum IL-6 regarding complications after pancreatic resection. Methods A retrospective analysis of patients with pancreatic resection at a tertiary German centre was performed. All IL-6 values per patient within 48 h after resection were delineated. Values at fixed postoperative time points were interpolated between each patient’s measurements and, beyond them, predicted from a linear mixed-effects model. Receiver operating characteristic curve analysis was performed, and optimal time and cut-off points for prediction of postoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF), postpancreatectomy acute pancreatitis (PPAP) and overall complications were set out. Results Out of 316 patients, 157 patients with more than one IL-6 value were included. IL-6 at 36 h after resection showed the best diagnostic performance for all three endpoints. For PPAP B/C, the AUC was 0.800 (95% CI 0.685–0.916) at a cut-off of 296 pg/ml (sensitivity 62%, specificity 80%, PPV 26%, NPV 95%), and for POPF B/C 0.715 (0.632–0.798) at 192 pg/ml (sensitivity 70%, specificity 59%, PPV 52%, NPV 76%). Discrimination for major complications (Clavien–Dindo ≥ 3b) was weaker, with an AUC of 0.636 (0.539–0.733) at 208 pg/ml (sensitivity 55%, specificity 62%, PPV 44%, NPV 73%). Conclusion Serum IL-6 within 48 h after pancreatic resection could be useful in risk assessment for pancreas-specific complications.
items.summary_cn: 该回顾性研究纳入157例胰腺切除患者，发现术后36小时血清IL-6对胰腺特异性并发症具有最佳预测效能：预测PPAP B/C的AUC为0.800（cut-off 296 pg/ml），预测POPF B/C的AUC为0.715（cut-off 192 pg/ml），但对Clavien-Dindo≥3b重大并发症的区分能力较弱（AUC 0.636）。结论认为术后48小时内血清IL-6有助于胰腺切除术后胰腺特异性并发症的风险分层。

items.title_cn: 护士结肠镜检查肠道准备知识、态度和实践：结构方程模型分析
items.title_en: Knowledge, attitudes, and practices of nurses regarding bowel preparation for colonoscopy: a structural equation modeling analysis
items.abstract_cn: 目的 本研究旨在调查护士对结肠镜检查肠道准备的知识、态度和实践情况。方法 本多中心横断面研究于2025年12月至2026年3月在中国江苏省八家医院的注册护士中开展。采用自行填写的在线问卷收集数据，内容包括人口学特征和KAP评分。采用多因素线性回归识别与KAP评分相关的因素，并采用结构方程模型（SEM）探讨知识、态度和实践之间的关系。结果 共纳入382份有效问卷。知识、态度和实践评分的中位数分别为10.00（9.00，14.00）、37.00（36.00，43.00）和28.00（23.00，32.00）。缺乏肠道准备相关培训与较低的知识评分（β = −4.097，95% CI：−5.006至−3.188）、态度评分（β = −1.052，95% CI：−2.000至−0.104）和实践评分（β = −2.297，95% CI：−3.335至−1.260）独立相关。SEM显示，知识分别与态度（β = 0.491，95% CI：0.407–0.584，P = 0.001）和实践（β = 0.707，95% CI：0.626–0.780，P = 0.002）存在显著的直接关联，知识通过态度与实践之间存在显著的间接关联（β = 0.068，95% CI：0.024–0.118，P = 0.002）。结论 护士对结肠镜检查肠道准备的知识不足，态度积极，实践处于中等水平。这些发现为未来针对护士的教育和组织干预确定了潜在靶点，尤其是知识缺口和肠道准备相关实践。
items.abstract_en: Objective This study aimed to investigate nurses' knowledge, attitude, and practice regarding bowel preparation for colonoscopy. Methods This multicenter cross-sectional study was conducted among registered nurses from eight hospitals in Jiangsu Province, China, between December 2025 and March 2026. Data were collected using a self-administered online questionnaire covering demographic characteristics and KAP scores. Multivariable linear regression was used to identify factors associated with KAP scores, and structural equation modeling (SEM) was used to explore the relationships among knowledge, attitudes, and practices. Results A total of 382 valid questionnaires were included. The median knowledge, attitude, and practice scores were 10.00 (9.00, 14.00), 37.00 (36.00, 43.00), and 28.00 (23.00, 32.00), respectively. Lack of bowel preparation-related training was independently associated with lower knowledge (β = −4.097, 95% CI: −5.006 to −3.188), attitude (β = −1.052, 95% CI: −2.000 to −0.104), and practice scores (β = −2.297, 95% CI: −3.335 to −1.260). SEM showed significant direct associations of knowledge with attitude (β = 0.491, 95% CI: 0.407–0.584, P = 0.001) and practice (β = 0.707, 95% CI: 0.626–0.780, P = 0.002), as well as a significant indirect association between knowledge and practice through attitude (β = 0.068, 95% CI: 0.024–0.118, P = 0.002). Conclusion Nurses demonstrated insufficient knowledge, positive attitudes, and moderate practice regarding bowel preparation for colonoscopy. These findings identify potential targets for future nurse-oriented educational and organizational interventions, particularly knowledge gaps and bowel preparation-related practices.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现护士在结肠镜检查肠道准备方面的知识不足、态度积极但实践水平中等，缺乏相关培训与知识、态度和实践得分较低独立相关；结构方程模型显示知识对态度和实践有直接关联，且知识通过态度对实践有间接关联。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
